purpose: Golden accept/reject vectors for the frozen managed-delivery contract spine. Hand-authored claims about each closed grammar: every family carries at least one accept and one reject vector, the journal-entry family carries one golden entry per active (journal, kind) pair, and reject vectors name the codes the validator must report. The implementation conforms to these vectors, never the reverse.
